name: Aldehuela de Liestos (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white embattled band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with yellow acorns at the upper fly and a yellow plant at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Aldehuela de Liestos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: embattled band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
